scope: Static stylesheet/source checks; no browser or preview rebuild.

checks.name: Stylesheet parses without errors
Layout loads new stylesheet exactly once after commerce/price
Desktop target at least44px
Mobile target at least44px
Labels can wrap within containing width
Primary uses native color variables with offset paper edge
Secondary uses cream/cobalt variables
Visible keyboard focus explicitly retained
Disabled state has no shadow/transform/transition
Hover effects are restricted to hover-capable devices
Reduced-motion overrides transition and movement
No arrow glyph or inserted pseudo-content
No header/gallery/Finder-card/text-link selectors
Single product purchase label keeps shared typography
light primary text contrast at least4.5:1
light primary-hover text contrast at least4.5:1
light secondary text contrast at least4.5:1
light secondary-hover text contrast at least4.5:1
light disabled text contrast at least4.5:1
dark primary text contrast at least4.5:1
dark primary-hover text contrast at least4.5:1
dark secondary text contrast at least4.5:1
dark secondary-hover text contrast at least4.5:1
dark disabled text contrast at least4.5:1

limits: CSS parsing, declared target sizes and exact color contrast are verified. Actual layout, label wrapping and clipping require visual review in the integrated preview.
No component markup, action hooks, gallery controls, Finder answer cards, header layout or text links changed.
qaNote: Initial no-generated-content assertion matched justify-content by substring; corrected to inspect the parsed content property. No CSS change was needed.
